caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a wooden butter churn. The butter churn is conical in shape, wider at the base and tapering toward the top. It is made of vertical wooden staves bound together by four horizontal metal bands, each colored in a rusty brown hue. The wood of the churn has a weathered grayish-brown appearance, showing variations in tone and grain. Emerging from the top center of the churn is a vertical wooden dasher handle, which is cylindrical and light brown in color. The churn and dasher are centered against a plain, light beige background, providing no additional objects or context. The artist’s signature "Isabel Nelson" is noted in small text near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Churn
